nom: Bioderma Sensibio AR+ CREAM Face Moisturizer for Sensitive & Redness prone skin

segments.sensitive: Reviewers repeatedly describe themselves as having very sensitive skin and report the cream absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and generally does not sting or irritate, though a minority still note tingling, irritation, or no visible benefit.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or drier skin report good hydration and smoother-feeling skin, with one noting reduced redness specifically on dry patches.
segments.combination: The few reviewers noting combination skin report the cream is hydrating and lightweight without a heavy feel, though one saw no real change in redness.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the cream calms redness and hydrates without feeling heavy, while another (unspecified oiliness) reports the product made her face extremely oily.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature skin as the reporting segment.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal skin as the reporting segment.

concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness, including several with rosacea, report visible calming or reduction, some within days and others gradually over weeks; a notable minority (including harsher rosacea/redness cases) report no noticeable difference at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer felt the product soothed her skin but did not meaningfully improve her skin barrier or resilience over a month of use; another links it to skin barrier support without detail.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin are mixed: several report no new breakouts even with sensitive/acne-prone skin, but others describe breakouts, clogged pores, or note the coconut oil ingredient causing acne.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the cream provides notable hydration, describing it as lightweight yet moisturizing and non-greasy, with effects lasting through the day for several users.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the cream left her face extremely oily, while others with oily-leaning skin describe it as non-greasy and lightweight; experiences diverge.

extraits.titre: Not for all types of redness
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product did not work for me. Did not notice any difference in reduced redness nor did it settle well under makeup. It did not leave any residue or feel oily. This product may work best for someone with not as harsh redness as myself.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't use western skincare very often but I thought I'd give this a try. The consistency is very thin and lightweight. It first applies oily but dries down very quickly which is nice. I have very sensitive skin and so far I haven't had any reactions but I also haven't seen any results either. The ingredients don't wow me but they seem to treat what the product claims. The price tag is a little outrageous to me especially since I associate Bioderma as a drugstore brand.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product may work well for most people but it does have coconut oil which can clog pores and gives me acne. Otherwise I think the ingredients are good.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been loving this moisturizer as a super sensitive skin girly with rosacea! A little bit goes a long way with this moisturizer, but also doesn't leave a greasy oily residue. i've been using it for about two weeks now and i haven't had any irritation or reaction to it. it also really helps with my redness and puffiness!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have very sensitive skin that is acne and redness prone with any change of routine. That being said, swapping my regular lotion with this didn't lead to any breakouts! It has no scent, goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, leaves my skin feeling hydrated and I do feel like it helped with overall redness in my cheeks with repeated daily use. It is a pretty small container, but a little product goes a long way. I would buy this again.

extraits.titre: This is perfect for sensitive skin!!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way the Bioderma AR+Cream feels on my skin! I have a combination skin with rosacea so I look for moisturizing but lightweight products to help my skin feel hydrated but less red and let me tell you this did the trick. The bottle is a perfect size with a fine squeeze tube applicator that i appreciate for applying products to my face.

extraits.titre: Calm redness and I love it!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream has a lightweight texture, absorbs quickly and helps calm redness while keeping skin hydrated without feeling heavy even in my oily skin. Great for daily use.
